title: LOSE YOUR WANTED LEVEL
yt_title: How to Lose the Cops in GTA 6 (3 Things They Remember)
hook: Here's how to lose your wanted level in GTA 6. The cops remember three things, and you have to clear all of them.
tips: 1. Cops track outfit, appearance and vehicle - clear all three (Zancudo Xi6a6cUYbEM 0:35-1:40; Mr Lawrence FGT8wNrw6Pw 1:26; TG cyAPzaLcEsM 1042 'cops are searching for you and they have your description')
2. Break the chase first: get out of the search area / alley (Zancudo 3:27; TG 1431)
3. Appearance: wheel > items > cap / glasses ('Appearance heat cleared' on frame) (Zancudo 4:41; TG 1460-1500)
4. Vehicle: paint spray / respray (TG 2577-2606; Zancudo; Mr Lawrence 1:35 respray, swap vehicle)
5. Leave the red heat zone on the map and the stars drop (Mr Lawrence 1:45; TG 2638-2660)

parts.text: Here's how to lose your wanted level in GTA 6. The cops remember three things, and you have to clear all three.
One. Check the icons under your stars. Outfit, appearance and vehicle. The message says they have your description.
parts.label: 1  Three icons
parts.proof: stars + icons, 'The cops are searching for you and they have your description' 1050-1056

parts.text: Two. Break the chase first. Get out of the search area and duck into an alley before you do anything else.
parts.label: 2  Break the chase
parts.proof: alley with 3 stars 2570-2586 (TG 1431 'pull into alley'; Zancudo step one)

parts.text: Three. Open the wheel, go to items, and put on a cap or glasses. It's free and takes seconds, and the game says appearance heat cleared.
parts.label: 3  Cap or glasses
parts.proof: character in cap 1470; items wheel + 'Appearance heat cleared' 1479-1502

parts.text: Four. Pull into a paint spray shop and pick respray. That clears the vehicle.
parts.label: 4  Respray the car
parts.proof: Repair/Respray menu 2590-2598, red respray 2602-2606 (TG 2592 'change the vehicle colour to reduce recognition')

parts.text: Five. Drive out of the red area on your map. Once you're clear of it, the stars drop away.
parts.label: 5  Leave the red zone
parts.proof: map with red search area 2618-2622; stars 3 -> 0 by 2636 (TG 2638 'out of the cop wanted area', 2660 'my wanted level is gone')

parts.text: Three icons, three fixes. Which one got you caught? Drop it in the comments.

desc_steps: 1. The cops remember three things: your outfit, your appearance and your vehicle. Look at the icons under your stars, and open the map to see which ones are still known.
2. Break the chase first. While the stars are white you are still being hunted, so get out of the search area or duck into an alley.
3. Fix your face: open the wheel, go to items, and put on a cap or glasses. It shows 'Appearance heat cleared'.
4. Fix your outfit: change clothes (a spare outfit in your trunk works), or swap to a different vehicle.
5. Fix your car: drive to a paint spray shop and pick Respray, or swap vehicles. The price is shown before you pay.
6. Leave the red heat zone on your map. When all three are cleared and you are out of the zone, your wanted level is gone.
credits: Tips via Zancudo (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Xi6a6cUYbEM) and Mr Lawrence (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FGT8wNrw6Pw)
verify: Tip: clear outfit + appearance + vehicle (Zancudo Xi6a6cUYbEM 0:35-1:40, Mr Lawrence FGT8wNrw6Pw 1:26-1:55) matched on Typical Gamer cyAPzaLcEsM: description message 1050, alley 1431, items wheel 'Appearance heat cleared' 1479-1502, respray menu 2590-2606, map red zone 2618, stars gone 2636. Step 4 outfit-swap and Zancudo's timings (42 s / 52 s) are not on frame, so they are description-only / omitted.
